scope: Complete installation and commissioning of one explicitly scoped UPS system with 2 selected online double-conversion UPS units UPS-20KVA-3P, rated 20 kVA each, and a 30-minute autonomy requirement. Downstream loads, general distribution, generators and unrelated low-voltage systems are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved electrical design organization, UPS integrator, equipment and battery manufacturer, commissioning authority and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved single-line diagram, UPS topology and selected equipment schedule
approved load, diversity, autonomy and battery calculation
approved input protection, output distribution and maintenance-bypass schedule
input, output, battery and protective-conductor cable schedules
installation method with labor, handling and test-equipment quantities
UPS startup, transfer, bypass, battery and autonomy test program
commissioning protocol and acceptance report schedule
conditional external-battery enclosure and monitoring schedules
UPS supplier package size and approved retained spare quantity
forbiddenClaims: UPS, cable or battery quantities derived from floor area alone
static 432-m route or generic electrical productivity
automatic load, battery, autonomy, protection, bypass or monitoring selection
universal spare quantity or supplier package
downstream loads, general distribution, generators or unrelated low-voltage systems included
